description: This script automates database migration and verification for a backend system. It resolves the database connection URL, runs Alembic migrations, and verifies the existence of specific tables and seed data using psycopg2.

methods.name: str resolve_sync_url()
methods.description: Constructs the database connection URL based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: subprocess.CompletedProcess run(cmd: list, extra_env: dict | None = None)
methods.description: Executes a command in a subprocess with optional extra environment variables.

methods.name: verify(conn)
methods.description: Connects to the database and verifies the presence of required tables and seed data.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates resolving the URL, running migrations, and verification.

ctags.pattern: /^def run(cmd: list, extra_env: dict | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:$/
